payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all point pairs to form lines (slope and intercept), group lines by slope, then count intersecting pairs as sum of products of group sizes for different slopes.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively enumerates all O(n^2) pairs to identify distinct lines, then uses combinatorics to count intersections. It does not employ branch-and-bound, backtracking, or graph search. The label 'search_branch_and_bound' is chosen as the recommended subtype but with low confidence due to lack of bounding.
